saw_lines: Road bike buyers check frame size and condition before anything else, so used bikes sell on trust.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the rider decides whether the bike deserves a second look.
Your 11 of 14 copy ads open on “+6 000 vélos de route”, so each rider hears one story. Write three openers from Specialized models and workshop checks, then test each.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 6 Nov 2026
points: 11 of your 14 copy ads open on “+6 000 vélos de route...”, so each rider sees one story. Buyers tune out a line they have read. Write three openers from Specialized models and workshop checks, test each against it.
Nine of your 14 copy ads share one exact text, so buyers see the same message. Repeated copy is easy to skip. Keep the text, but change the opening line and the product photo in each of the nine ads.
None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number, so a first time buyer has little to trust. Count the bikes you have shipped, print that number on the creative, and open the next batch with it.
16 of your 30 ads are catalog ads with no story, so the feed gives a rider no reason to stop. Add three story ads showing a workshop check or a road bike ride, each with its own opening line.
